description: Validating a data model value. 'files', when present, lists the overlay's files and every file a field names must be among them. An invalid case names the pointer of the offending value ('at'); an implementation reports a problem there or inside it. A case whose document writes 'about' also states whether the manifest still 'applies': a problem under /about never stops it.
